text:
Ben (Partnerships): Quick sync — need final structure for marketplace private offer with AtlasHW + SI bundle. Goals: simple SKUs for cloud listing, commit tier incentives, renewal smoothing, and co-sell credit for SI. Thoughts?

Alice (Partner Ops): Proposal: 3 commit tiers (S/M/L) with % off vs on-demand. SI co-sell credit = 10% of committed ARR for first year. Renewal: 12-month true-up window, 30% auto-renew discount cap. :thinking_face:

Carmen (Finance): We can allow 25% off first-year for L tier but must tier discount cliffing: 25% -> 15% second year -> 10% thereafter. Need revenue recognition note re: credits. Will model.

Dinesh (Sales): Sku naming idea: AtlasHW-Commit-S-[monthly|annual] e.g., Atlas-Commit-L-12m. Sales needs a "convert to reserved" clause for customers hitting 70% usage. Also want soft-credits for SI to apply on initial invoice.

Emily (Legal): No external joint announcement until contractual IP and logos sign-off. Private offer terms need explicit non-publication clause and a simple sample contract addendum. Also approve SI credit mechanics.

marketplace-bot: Private offer created in test marketplace: offerId=po-20240304-83, status=draft

Ben (Partnerships): Thanks. Can we lock in numbers this week? Action items:
- Alice: prepare marketplace draft SKUs + seller-facing brief (due Wed)
- Carmen: run impact model for FY1–FY3 (due Thu)
- Dinesh: capture sales play + one-pager for AE enablement (due Fri)
- Emily: draft addendum + non-publication clause (due Fri)
- @everyone: no public press until legal sign-off, internal co-sell channel only.

Alice (Partner Ops): Draft brief attached in thread (will DM doc link). Quick snippet for marketplace UI:

```
OfferId: po-20240304-83
Name: AtlasHW Bundle - L (12m)
Price: $750k committed
Discount: 25%
SICredit: 10% of committed
RenewalCap: 30% discount max
Notes: Private offer; subject to addendum.
```

Dinesh (Sales): +1. Also suggest "early-adopter" promo for first 3 customers: waived onboarding fee (up to $50k) and an executive briefing.

Carmen (Finance): If we add waived onboarding, offset by lower SI credit by 2% or cap total credits at $60k.

Emily (Legal): Fine with cap. I'll push draft today.

Ben (Partnerships): Perfect. We'll reconvene Thu EOD to finalize. :rocket:
